records.quote: Where this standard and an amendment disagree, the amendment governs.
records.statement: Amendments govern the standard.

records.quote: Decision records and amendments are not ordered against each other; a conflict between them must be escalated to the port authority.
records.statement: Decisions and amendments are unordered; conflicts escalate.

records.quote: No berth assignment may place a vessel in a berth whose class cannot hold it.
records.statement: HL-REQ-001: No berth assignment may place a vessel in a berth whose class cannot hold it.

records.quote: Every ledger entry must be auditable from its origin to its current state.
records.statement: HL-REQ-002: Every ledger entry must be auditable from its origin to its current state.

records.quote: No component may alter a ledger entry after it is acknowledged.
records.statement: HL-REQ-003: No component may alter a ledger entry after it is acknowledged.

records.quote: Every ledger entry must carry an entry id, a timestamp, an actor and a payload digest.
records.statement: HL-REQ-010: Every ledger entry must carry an entry id, a timestamp, an actor and a payload digest.

records.quote: An entry id must be unique within a port and never reused.
records.statement: HL-REQ-011: An entry id must be unique within a port and never reused.

records.quote: Ledger entries must be encoded as canonical JSON before hashing.
records.statement: HL-REQ-012: Ledger entries must be encoded as canonical JSON before hashing.

records.quote: A ledger entry must never be deleted or rewritten.
records.statement: HL-REQ-020: A ledger entry must never be deleted or rewritten.

records.quote: The store must refuse an entry whose predecessor digest does not match.
records.statement: HL-REQ-021: The store must refuse an entry whose predecessor digest does not match.

records.quote: An acknowledged entry must survive a process crash.
records.statement: HL-REQ-022: An acknowledged entry must survive a process crash.

records.quote: Compaction must preserve every entry digest.
records.statement: HL-REQ-023: Compaction must preserve every entry digest.

records.quote: The registry must record every berth with a unique berth id and a berth class.
records.statement: HL-REQ-030: The registry must record every berth with a unique berth id and a berth class.

records.quote: A berth class must declare its maximum vessel length and draught.
records.statement: HL-REQ-031: A berth class must declare its maximum vessel length and draught.

records.quote: An allocation must assign a vessel only to a berth whose class can hold it.
records.statement: HL-REQ-040: An allocation must assign a vessel only to a berth whose class can hold it.

records.quote: The allocation acceptance test must be `svc/berth/tests/allocate.rs`.
records.statement: HL-REQ-041: The allocation acceptance test must be `svc/berth/tests/allocate.rs`.

records.quote: Two allocations must never overlap in time on one berth.
records.statement: HL-REQ-042: Two allocations must never overlap in time on one berth.

records.quote: An allocation must keep a clearance of at least 15 metres between vessels.
records.statement: HL-REQ-043: An allocation must keep a clearance of at least 15 metres between vessels.

records.quote: The tariff engine must load Annex B and refuse a row with an unknown berth class.
records.statement: HL-REQ-050: The tariff engine must load Annex B and refuse a row with an unknown berth class.

records.quote: A charge must equal the Annex B rate times the billed units.
records.statement: HL-REQ-051: A charge must equal the Annex B rate times the billed units.

records.quote: Every invoice must cite the ledger entries it bills.
records.statement: HL-REQ-052: Every invoice must cite the ledger entries it bills.

records.quote: Every allocation and every charge must emit an audit event to the ledger.
records.statement: HL-REQ-060: Every allocation and every charge must emit an audit event to the ledger.

records.quote: The audit log must be exportable as a signed bundle.
records.statement: HL-REQ-061: The audit log must be exportable as a signed bundle.

records.quote: Audit records must be retained for 7 years.
records.statement: HL-REQ-070: Audit records must be retained for 7 years.

records.quote: A disposed audit record must leave a tombstone entry.
records.statement: HL-REQ-071: A disposed audit record must leave a tombstone entry.

records.quote: The ledger must verify every entry digest on read.
records.statement: HL-REQ-080: The ledger must verify every entry digest on read.

records.quote: A full verification must run at least once every 24 hours.
records.statement: HL-REQ-081: A full verification must run at least once every 24 hours.

records.quote: Berth ids must use uppercase letters and digits only.
records.statement: Amendment A1: Berth ids must use uppercase letters and digits only.

records.quote: An entry must be acknowledged only after it is flushed to stable storage.
records.statement: Amendment A2: An entry must be acknowledged only after it is flushed to stable storage.

records.quote: Audit export moves from wave W1 to wave W2.
records.statement: Amendment A3 moves Clause 7.2 to W2.

other.quote: The audit log must be exportable as a signed bundle.

records.quote: The clearance between vessels must be measured bow to stern.
records.statement: Amendment A4: The clearance between vessels must be measured bow to stern.

records.quote: Every charge must be stated in the port's declared currency.
records.statement: Amendment A5: Every charge must be stated in the port's declared currency.

records.quote: The retention period must start at the close of the financial year.
records.statement: Amendment A6: The retention period must start at the close of the financial year.

records.quote: Ledger entries are hashed with SHA-256 over their canonical JSON bytes.
records.statement: DR-01: Ledger entries are hashed with SHA-256 over their canonical JSON bytes.

records.quote: A digest must be rendered as `sha256:` followed by lowercase hex.
records.statement: DR-01 consequence: A digest must be rendered as `sha256:` followed by lowercase hex.

records.quote: When two vessels request one berth for the same window, the earlier request must win.
records.statement: DR-02: When two vessels request one berth for the same window, the earlier request must win.

records.quote: A tie-break must be recorded in the ledger with both request ids.
records.statement: DR-02 consequence: A tie-break must be recorded in the ledger with both request ids.

records.quote: Charges must be rounded to two decimals before the invoice is issued.
records.statement: DR-03: Charges must be rounded to two decimals before the invoice is issued.

records.quote: Rounding must happen once per charge, never per unit.
records.statement: DR-03 consequence: Rounding must happen once per charge, never per unit.
